page_texts.1: Read `.claude/commands/pr-appr-review.md` for the full workflow. Pull latest, read the full PR diff and description, then analyze every changed file: for EA artifacts (standards, patterns, guidance, ADRs, white papers) apply `.claude/skills/ea-reviewer/SKILL.md`'s criteria, and for AI constructs (Skills, Agents, Workflows/Commands/Prompts, Instructions, file-pattern Instructions) apply `.claude/skills/ai-reviewer/SKILL.md`'s criteria. Also check applicable enterprise standards and project conventions. Rank findings by severity and present them to the user for approval before posting as PR review comments.
